summary: Frontend-only (Playwright) testing of the unified .pf-toast flash system in the Laravel 12 + Inertia + Vue3 'artirdim' app via public preview URL. Verified: admin login, category create+delete toasts (no stale/duplicate re-render), contact form toast (no inline banner, no reappearance on later navigation), plain SPA navigation produces no toast, profile update & password change (no full page reload, toast shown), admin user create/delete toasts. 5 of 6 requested scenarios pass. Two real issues found: (1) several Inertia pages still render an INLINE green success banner in addition to the toast (Admin/Users/Show duplicate confirmed live); (2) profile 'Genel' save is blocked by native HTML5 required validation on the empty GSM field (browser tooltip 'Please fill out this field.'), so a user without a phone cannot save the name at all until phone is filled.

ui_bugs.issue: Inline flash banner still rendered (v-if="flash.success" .pf-alert-success/.alert-success) so the user sees the message TWICE: inline green box AND the toast. Confirmed live on /admin/users/105 after create ('TEST_QA_User2 oluşturuldu.') and after edit ('Kullanıcı başarıyla güncellendi.') — banner + toast simultaneously. Requirement was to replace all HTML success messages with toasts.

input[name=phone] has HTML `required`; admin user has no phone, so clicking 'Kaydet' only triggers the browser's native validation bubble ('Please fill out this field.') and the form never submits — no toast, no update. Native browser tooltip is also inconsistent with the app's .pf-error styling. Either make phone optional (frontend+backend, General/ProfileController line 253 requires it) or show an app-styled inline error.

Toasts are not deduped/superseded: doing create then delete within the 2.6s toast lifetime leaves BOTH toasts stacked on screen at the same time ('... oluşturuldu.' + '... silindi.'). Verified with DOM tagging that the create toast is NOT re-created (original stale-flash bug IS fixed) — it is simply still alive. User's explicit requirement: add/delete toasts should never be on screen simultaneously → dismiss/replace previous toast when a new one is shown (or cap host to 1 toast).

Hint says 'En az 8 karakter, büyük/küçük harf ve sembol içermeli' and the strength meter shows red, yet submitting the weak password 'password' succeeded with 'Şifreniz başarıyla güncellendi.' — client hint/meter and server policy are inconsistent.

Legacy blade views still print inline @if(session('success')) alerts: seller/auctions/index, seller/sales/index+show, admin/auctions, admin/orders, admin/support/show, buyer/orders, general/balance, general/support. Not migrated to the toast system (not exercised in browser this run).

issues: Native browser validation tooltip used instead of styled inline error
Footer state chip still reads 'Kaydedilmedi' in the screenshot taken right after a successful save (dirty flag not reset because preserveState:true) — minor state-sync polish

action_items: Remove the remaining inline flash.success banners from Pages/Admin/Users/Show.vue, Pages/Admin/Users/Index.vue, Pages/Admin/Auctions/Index.vue+Show.vue, Pages/Admin/Orders/Index.vue+Show.vue (toast already covers them).

Make the profile phone field non-required (or surface an app-styled error) so name-only profile updates are possible; also relax/align backend validation in app/Http/Controllers/General/ProfileController.php:253.
Make appToast supersede/dismiss the previous toast so 'eklendi' and 'silindi' can never be visible together.
Align password strength hint with actual server rules (or enforce the stated policy).
Migrate legacy blade session('success') alerts to appToast for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: app.js flash->toast bridge correctly suppresses partial reloads (visit.only) — verified via DOM tagging that no stale toast is re-created; keep this guard.
Inertia flash props are shared as closures, so full visits always return fresh (empty) flash — no re-display on navigation, verified across /, /contact, /admin/users, /admin/categories.
Duplicate messaging channels (inline banner + toast) remain in 6 Inertia pages — single source of truth should be the toast.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 requested scenarios pass; profile 'Genel' save only works after filling the required phone field)

seed_data_creation: Temporary data created and cleaned up: categories TEST_Kategori_QA1/QA2/QA3 (all deleted), users TEST_QA_User (id 104) and TEST_QA_User2 (id 105) (both deleted). Admin profile: name restored to 'Admin'; NOTE admin phone was set to 5551112233 (was empty) and admin password re-saved as 'password' (unchanged value).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit. Category create: /admin/categories/create → category-name + category-save; delete: admin-category-delete-{id} then .swal2-confirm. User create: /admin/users/create, password fields live under the 'Rol & Şifre' tab, submit button testid user-save-2; delete: user-delete-{id} + .swal2-confirm. Contact: contact-subject is a <select> (use select_option, values genel/teknik/...). Profile: click 'Profili Düzenle', form has input[name=name] and REQUIRED input[name=phone]; to detect full reload set window.__marker before submit and read it after. Toasts live in #pf-toast-host .pf-toast and auto-remove ~2.9s; tag existing toasts with an attribute before the next action to distinguish new vs still-alive toasts.
rca_of_the_issue: Reported duplicate/stale toast bug is fixed: router.on('success') skips partial visits (visit.only) so flash props left over on the client are not re-emitted; DOM tagging proved the 'oluşturuldu' toast after a delete is the original element still inside its 2.6s lifetime, not a re-render. The remaining visible duplication comes from Vue pages that still render flash.success as an inline .pf-alert-success box on top of the toast. The profile-save failure is client-side HTML5 constraint validation on the required-but-empty phone input, which blocks @submit.prevent from ever firing.
